text: This capstone provisions the actual infrastructure a small data platform needs before a single pipeline can run — a resource group, a Storage Account, an Event Hub, and a Fabric Capacity, provisioned together.
The Storage Account and Event Hub live inside a reusable landing-zone module, called once from a root configuration that provisions the resource group and Fabric Capacity directly.
This isn't a demo with local state. The azurerm backend is configured before the first apply, so a second engineer picking this up later has the same state to work from.
Plan runs first, naming every resource about to be created across both the root configuration and the module. Only after review does apply actually create anything.
Same resource types, organized with modules, protected by remote state, reviewed before applying. Next up: wrapping up the capstone and this course.
